requirements:
pytest
mozversion
taskgraph
redo
requests
voluptuous
mozrunner
mozinstall
mozprofile
PyYAML
mozilla_version
mozdownload
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "-c", "print('Fenix test environment ready')"]
explanation: The requirements.txt includes all detected imports except the empty string, with PyYAML as the correct package name for yaml. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as base, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, copies the application code, and sets a default command to verify the environment.
